instructorNote: Pressure inject: the board's main notice channel fails just as the GC starts the 19:20 briefing. Watch whether the GC skips the retry queue, phones Dr. Samuel Obuya now and sends the written notice another way, such as by courier. The CISO should keep the directory isolated rather than reconnect it to bring the portal back. The Audit Committee Chair should ask that the time of notice be logged for the minutes.
